clips.title: The story
paras: In the Royal Quarter, Varimathras advises Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and commands her forces. Defeated during the civil war for Lordaeron, the dreadlord pledged himself to the Banshee Queen and now stands at her right hand in the Undercity.

Before the Third War, Kil'jaeden sent Varimathras and his fellow dreadlords to Azeroth to guard the Lich King and ensure Ner'zhul's spirit served the Legion's plans. With his brothers Detheroc and Balnazzar, Varimathras oversaw the Scourge in Lordaeron while Archimonde invaded Kalimdor. The Legion fell at Mount Hyjal, but the three dreadlords remained entrenched in the ruins of the Capital City. They did not learn of their master's defeat until Prince Arthas returned and drove them into hiding.

As the Lich King's hold over his undead forces weakened, Varimathras tried to make the newly freed banshee Sylvanas Windrunner serve the dreadlords' new regime. Sylvanas refused and rallied liberated undead to destroy his outpost. Facing execution, Varimathras begged for his life and offered tactical secrets, including knowledge of his brothers' fortifications. Sylvanas spared him and bound him to her service as a weapon against his kin.
